last_text: API Error: Unable to connect to API: SSL certificate verification failed (UNABLE_TO_GET_ISSUER_CERT_LOCALLY). The certificate comes from an authority Claude Code doesn't trust, usually a TLS-inspecting corporate proxy or a gateway signed by a private CA: set NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS to that CA bundle, or add it to the system certificate store · see https://code.claude.com/docs/en/network-config
